technique_name: Summarize the book "The Goldfinch" by Donna Tartt
description: The Goldfinch is a 2013 novel by bestselling author Donna Tartt. It tells the story of Theodore Decker, an orphan boy from Las Vegas, who is caught in the middle of a chaotic world when his mother is killed in a bomb explosion while visiting the Metropolitan Museum of Art. After this, his world is changed forever, as he finds himself dealing with a world of art, antiques, and crime.
